headline:
Rec or travel?
Start here.
body: The program matters more than the label.
questions: Ask how new players join and which age groups are offered.
Ask about selection, training, travel and the full cost.
The name alone does not explain the level. Ask what the program includes.
Pick something that fits the player, the schedule and the budget.
caption:
Recreational. Travel. Academy.

The labels help, but they do not tell you what a normal week will look like.

If you are exploring a first club, ask how new players join, which age group fits and what the weekly commitment costs. For competitive programs, ask about selection and travel as well.

On Cancha, start with youth recreational clubs, add your city or ZIP and open a few profiles. Then talk to the clubs that suit your family. Link in our bio.

Which detail do you wish clubs made easier to find?

headline:
Still looking
for a team?
body: Compare Florida clubs by area and level.
cta: Search your city or ZIP on Cancha.
caption:
You still want to play. Finding a team should be the easy part.

Start with adult club profiles on Cancha. Search your city or ZIP, then choose the level you want. Open a profile for its official information and check recruitment directly with the club.

A league listing does not mean the team is holding open tryouts. Dated trials and camps are listed separately under Tryouts & events.
Find adult clubs through the link in our bio. Add your city or ZIP and use the age/level filters.

headline:
Where do you
play in Broward?
body: Explore local venues. Tell us what is missing.
caption:
A regular game usually starts with someone who knows the place.

Our first venue guides cover places in Broward, including Weston Regional Park, Boggs Park and Pine Trails Park. Read the profile and confirm the access rules before you go. Some spaces need permission or a reservation.

These are venue profiles, not scheduled Cancha pickup games. We want to learn where people already play and where a local group would be useful.
Open the link in our bio and choose Places to explore the venue guides.

Which city and venue should we look into next? Share the place, not private contact details.
